title: Fix laser/sensor noise model: treat noise_mean as zero, not bias
description: LaserSimulator (and likely other sensors) apply noise as a std::normal_distribution with config.noise.mean as the mean, then add the sample directly to the true range. With hokuyo's noise_mean=0.5, every beam gets a +0.5 m bias — visible as beams overextending obstacles in standalone GUI. Fix: center noise at zero (zero-mean Gaussian) so noise_mean acts as documented variance-only config. Audit all sensor simulators for the same pattern.
notes: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/bgill92/stdr_simulator/pull/23 (base: jazzy-devel). Awaiting review before merge.

Sonar max-range sentinel emits range > max_range on no-hit
description: In stdr_simulation/src/sensors/sonar_simulator.cpp around line 76, when the inner ray loop finds no obstacle, min_steps remains max_steps + 1, so the computed range is (max_steps + 1) * map.resolution, which exceeds config.max_range by one cell (e.g., 5.1 m for max_range=5, resolution=0.1). The subsequent clamp at line 88 uses >= config.max_range so it gets flipped to +infinity — the current documented behavior — but the intermediate value is off-by-one. Likely fix: use min_steps = max_steps as the 'no hit' sentinel so the natural no-hit range equals max_range exactly, or restructure to set range to +inf directly on no-hit. Pre-existing bug discovered during review of stdr_simulator-3v6 noise fix.
